turns.speaker: wren
turns.text: Hey Maya. Good to hear your voice today. How are you holding up?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Hey Wren. Honestly, not great. I have some pretty bad news on the job front.

turns.speaker: wren
turns.text: I'm right here with you. What happened?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Well, Corvid Labs passed on me. I got the rejection email yesterday for that SDR position, right after finishing the hiring manager interview.

turns.speaker: wren
turns.text: Oh, Maya, I'm sorry. That was a big round to get through. How did it feel when the email came in?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: It stung. I thought the chat with the hiring manager actually went well, so seeing the canned no thanks was rough.

turns.speaker: wren
turns.text: That kind of drop after feeling good about a conversation really hurts. How are your energy levels today?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Honestly, waking up today, I just feel totally flat and discouraged about everything.

turns.speaker: wren
turns.text: That makes complete sense. A letdown like that takes the wind right out of you. Have you told anyone else about it yet?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: No, not yet. I haven't really wanted to bring it up with my friends or family because I'm just tired of talking about interviews.

turns.speaker: wren
turns.text: That's okay too. You don't have to broadcast it until you're ready. Do you want to unpack what happened, or would you rather take a breather today?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I think I just need a breather. My brain feels kind of foggy, and doing mock questions right now sounds awful.

turns.speaker: wren
turns.text: No drills today, promise. What is one small thing you can do this afternoon that has nothing to do with applications?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I might just go for a walk outside and grab some iced coffee, then finish a book I started last week.

turns.speaker: wren
turns.text: That sounds like a solid plan. Would you like to check in again tomorrow once you've had a little space?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Yeah, tomorrow sounds a lot better. Thanks for listening, Wren.

turns.speaker: wren
turns.text: Any time, Maya. Go enjoy that walk and coffee, okay?
